verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's first-party hosted MCP Server (Beta) lets users operate payments in natural language through an AI agent in their IDE: querying payment statuses, issuing refunds, voiding payments, and creating and managing payment links, with OAuth against the Dashboard account. This is real natural-language operation, but it is beta, covers only a subset of operations, and depends on an external AI client. The agentic-commerce ChatGPT/Google integrations are about customers paying, not merchants operating the product, so they do not count here. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the Dashboard, natural-language coverage beyond payments, refunds, voids and links (e.g. disputes, fraud rules, reporting, platforms), GA status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
